title: poincianella pluviosa var. paraensis
intro: Poincianella pluviosa var. paraensis, commonly known as the "Para Rubber Tree", is a plant species that belongs to the family Fabaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in the Amazon region, where its leaves and bark are used to treat various health conditions. The Para Rubber Tree has been reported to possess several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help in the management of fever, pain, and infections. The plant's bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and terpenoids, are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antipyretic, analgesic, and antibacterial effects.
